fills.researcher_notes: IMPORTANT -- I could NOT find two independently-differing sourced lengths for Waha-Nasser (P1860) vs Faregh-Intesar (P1861); the best available source gives the SAME ~110 km figure for both, which explains (but does not eliminate) the duplicate-optics concern flagged in the brief. OPEC ASB Table 4.10 (opec.org PDFs dead live; recovered via Wayback + pdftotext per the protocol's gotcha; url_verifier FAILs on both PDFs -- can't substring-match compressed PDF streams, a known false-negative, manually confirmed by me) lists, in the SAME table, both editions: ASB2012 (2011 data) 'Faregh/Intesar, Waha, 110, 24in, 7,080,147' and ASB2013 (2012 data) the same route as '68.2' mi (68.2 x 1.609 = 109.75 km, matching ASB2012's raw 110 almost exactly) -- i.e. OPEC's own Waha-submitted data independently repeats the identical length (110 in both editions) for BOTH Waha/Nasser and Faregh/Intesar, with only the capacity/amount-transported columns differing between the two rows. This means the 177.00/177.00 duplicate now on the sheet is NOT a GEM copy-paste error -- it traces straight back to the primary source itself, which reports the same length twice (then GEM applied the same double miles/km conversion bug found on P1856/P1857/P1860 in this cluster: 110 x 1.609 = 176.99 -> 177.00 for both rows). Whether Waha Oil Co's two spur lines from Farigh and Waha to their respective junctions are genuinely near-identical in length, or whether this is an estimating shortcut/data-quality artifact in Waha's own OPEC submission, I cannot determine independently -- no non-OPEC source gives a length for this specific line at all. Proposing the corrected LengthKnownKm=110 (matching what the source actually says) while flagging the residual same-value-for-two-lines concern for a human (see validity note) rather than silently resolving it.

OPEC ASB (same PDF family cited for the length fill) independently lists owner/operator 'Waha' for Faregh/Intesar, corroborating the value but not counted as a second independent source since it's the same document family already cited on this row.
